name: atlas-shared
description: Atlas — the FE/BE shared contract package. Holds the Zod schemas (domain entities + the WebSocket frame envelope, ADR-003) and the pure turf-backed geo module (route projection, length, ETA, geofence hysteresis, ADR-002/ADR-004). Both atlas-server and atlas-web depend on it: the server imports impl + types (runtime validation, the engine's geo math), the web imports types-only for the WS contract and impl for the client-side geo (remaining-route slice, interpolation geometry). This is the conventions section 5 single-source discipline applied to both schemas and algorithms.
